reason: 该插件的主要面向用户价值是通过 Git 在多设备间同步 DSH 工作区数据（对话/会话与可选全量文件），并提供在设置页执行拉取/推送及新设备接入的工作流，因此归类为文件与工作流工具类插件。证据来自 README 中的双模式同步说明、仓库克隆接入流程与会话路径适配说明，以及包清单中对 DSH Web 插件与相关运行时依赖的定义。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在多设备间通过 Git 同步 DSH 工作区数据，支持仅对话或全量文件同步，并提供拉取/推送和新设备接入流程。
summaries.en: This plugin syncs DSH workspace data across devices via Git, supporting conversation-only or full-file sync modes with pull/push workflows and new-device workspace onboarding.

capabilities: Synchronizes DSH workspace conversation logs and optionally full workspace files via Git.
Provides push/pull/status operations against a user-configured remote repository.
Performs cross-device workspace onboarding by cloning and registering a workspace on a new device.
Rewrites pulled session path metadata so sessions can be resumed on a different machine.

reasons.code: README states two modes: conversation-only sync and all-files sync, both intended for multi-device continuity.
README and installation docs describe a Git sync flow with push/pull/status actions for each workspace.
README describes 'new device: clone workspace' flow with remote repository URL and local path setup.
Package metadata identifies the plugin as a DSH web plugin and includes dependencies for subprocess/workspace integration, matching a local sync tool.
